The “Real Characters” category is further divided into seven segments labeled “Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers,” all rendered in a light green color. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segments positioned at the top and bottom of the chart.
model_annotations.English: This donut-style pie chart visually represents a categorization of characters into two main groups: “Virtual Characters” and “Real Characters,” with the central “Virtual Characters” section appearing as a large blue circle and the surrounding “Real Characters” section divided into multiple smaller segments. The “Virtual Characters” category is further subdivided into “Comic Characters,” “Movie Characters,” “Novel Characters,” and “Game Characters,” each represented by a light blue slice. The “Real Characters” category is broken down into “Custom Characters,” “Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers,” with “Custom Characters” shown in a distinct red slice and the others in various shades of green. The chart includes a legend that matches each category to its color, and the “Custom Characters” slice is slightly exploded or offset from the rest, drawing visual emphasis. While no percentage values are explicitly labeled on the chart, the relative sizes of the slices suggest that “Virtual Characters” as a whole constitutes the largest portion, followed by “Real Characters,” which is further divided into multiple smaller segments. The segments appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order of size from left to right, starting with “Comic Characters” and ending with “Influencers.”
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt eine zweistufige Aufteilung von Charakterarten, wobei der äußere Ring verschiedene Kategorien von „Virtual Characters“ darstellt, darunter „Comic Characters“, „Movie Characters“, „Novel Characters“ und „Game Characters“, die jeweils in einem hellblauen Segment dargestellt sind, während der innere Ring „Real Characters“ in einem grünen Segment und „Custom Characters“ in einem rosa Segment enthält; „Real Characters“ umfasst weitere kleinere Segmente wie „Scientists“, „Artists“, „Athletes“, „Writers“, „Musicians“, „Actors“ und „Influencers“, die jeweils in verschiedenen Grüntönen gehalten sind und zusammen einen deutlich kleineren Anteil als der äußere Ring ausmachen; das Diagramm enthält keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente oder eine Legende, aber die Segmente sind visuell nach Größe und Farbe unterscheidbar und scheinen im äußeren Ring nach absteigender Größe angeordnet zu sein.
